You gain a +[1] bonus to Initiative rolls. This scales with your Rogue level.

You no longer need Advantage to use Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within [3] of it, no other creatures are within [2] of you, and you don't have Disadvantage on the Attack Roll. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.

Deal <font color="#ffffff">[1] extra damage</font> to a creature you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against, or if an ally who is not <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INCAPACITATED">Incapacitated</LSTag> is within [2] of the target creature and you don't have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.

Deal [1] extra damage to a creature you have Advantage against, or if an ally who is not Incapacitated is within [2] of the target creature and you don't have Disadvantage.

You can also use this attack without Advantage if you are within [3] of it, no other creatures are within [2] of you, and you don't have Disadvantage on the Attack Roll. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.

Deal [1] extra damage to a creature you have Advantage against, or if an ally who is not Incapacitated is within [2] of the target creature and you don't have Disadvantage.

You can also use this attack with any weapon that isn't Two-Handed, so long as you are proficient with the weapon.
Deal <font color="#ffffff">[1] extra damage</font> and attempt to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DWE_CUNNING_STRIKE_POISON">Poison</LSTag> the target for up to 10 rounds.
Turn your attack into a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself.

You can use a Reaction to halve incoming damage.

Once per turn, you can deal extra damage when you hit with an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> made with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> or against an enemy standing near your allies. The attack must use a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse</LSTag> or ranged weapon.
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
